purpose: Track visual-identity and output-presentation leakage that must be remediated before the Output Visual Identity candidate may be promoted to canonical.

findings.evidence: src/components/Header.tsx uses Sigma as an ad-hoc logo and MATH AI STUDIO as the visually primary brand.
findings.required: Use MST-MATH as primary brand text in product UI. Do not treat Sigma or another arbitrary math glyph as an official mark. Learning artifacts and video must contain no promotional MST-MATH branding.

findings.evidence: Multiple UI files hard-code Tailwind blue/slate/emerald/rose visual roles rather than resolving MST-MATH core semantic color tokens.
findings.required: Migrate UI semantic roles to core token bindings without changing mathematical/business logic.

findings.evidence: UI uses Lucide glyphs directly for several semantic concepts.
findings.required: Classify each glyph as UI chrome or semantic icon. Semantic icons must resolve through MST-MATH Semantic Icons; purely operational UI chrome must not become a parallel semantic icon authority.

findings.evidence: Exercise Sheet has identity color and inherited textbook/layout authorities but no explicit exercise-specific composition profile.
findings.required: Validate candidate P04 composition using an A4 Golden Case before canonical promotion.

findings.evidence: Video has strong macro layout and font authority but no previously approved explicit readable type scale.
findings.required: Validate MST_MATH_VIDEO_TYPE_SCALE_V1.0 on 1080p classroom display and derivative outputs while enforcing no promotional branding.

findings.evidence: Game reference defines gameplay/screens but does not define a complete visual token system.
findings.required: Validate MST_MATH_GAME_VISUAL_SYSTEM_V1.0 on a real classroom TV/projector Golden Case.
Bind to current locked MST-MATH Dynamic Geometry authorities.

findings.evidence: No approved MST-MATH graphic logo/wordmark master asset is present in the active assets namespace; only semantic icon assets are present.
findings.required: Use text-only MST-MATH identity in product UI until a human-approved graphic mark exists. This does not block learning artifacts because those artifacts must not display promotional branding.

findings.evidence: MST_MATH_OUTPUT_CONTENT_PRESENTATION_POLICY_V1.1 is locked and registered, but every renderer/export path still needs explicit runtime gate enforcement.
findings.required: Before final export, resolve V1.1 and block rendering when A4, page-number, no-branding, pedagogical-reflow, student-workspace, answer-section, figure-containment or answer-QA gates fail.

findings.evidence: Canonical policy requires figures to remain wholly within their owning question/answer region, preserve aspect ratio, remain sharp, avoid student workspace and never split across pages.
findings.required: Implement/verify renderer QA for figure ownership bounds, final A4 readability, vector preference or >=300 effective dpi raster, no crop/blur/pixelation, no overlap and whole-question page move before unsafe shrink.

findings.evidence: Canonical policy requires mathematical, logical, pedagogical and answer-key verification before any answer-bearing A4 artifact may be exported.
findings.required: Integrate ANSWER_QA_PASS as a hard export gate. MCQ must verify key/result alignment and absence of multiple correct distractors; true/false must verify each statement independently; short answer must verify accepted forms, rounding and units.

findings.evidence: V1.1 permits question/example reorder only when the learning dependency graph remains valid and meaningful whitespace is distinguished from intentional student workspace.
findings.required: Implement dependency-aware reflow that records original order, rendered order and reason; reject reorder across prerequisite, scaffolding, shared-stem, scenario-continuity or previous-result dependencies.

findings.evidence: V1.1 requires ruled notebook-like writing space for every question, including MCQ, using 7.0 mm line pitch with adaptive minimum row counts.
findings.required: Implement question-owned ruled workspace in P01/P03. Minimum rows: MCQ 2, True/False 3, Short Answer 4, Constructed Response 6, Open Investigation 8; never shrink below minimum merely to fill the page.

findings.evidence: V1.1 requires a visible page number at the bottom center of every A4 page, including the first page and answer pages.
findings.required: Implement page numbering in every A4 renderer/export path with no promotional footer text and no collision with content/trim.

rule: Candidate visual standards may be implemented and tested, but must not be promoted to LOCKED/CANONICAL while promotion blockers remain unresolved or explicitly waived by the human product owner. Locked human-approved output presentation policy V1.1 is already authoritative and may not be bypassed.
